The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged. Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024, FY2023, FY2022: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed.
